message.content:
Opioids are **not all derived from one thing**: some are **natural** compounds from the **opium poppy plant**, some are **semi-synthetic** drugs made by chemically modifying those natural compounds, and some are **fully synthetic** drugs made in laboratories.[1][3]

- **Natural opioids**: made from the seed pods of the **opium poppy**; examples include **morphine**, **codeine**, **opium**, and **thebaine**.[1]
- **Semi-synthetic opioids**: made in a lab by chemically processing natural opioids; examples include **heroin**, **oxycodone**, **hydrocodone**, and **oxymorphone**.[1]
- **Synthetic opioids**: manufactured entirely in a lab, with no natural ingredients; example: **fentanyl**.[1]

If you meant **opiates** specifically, those are the **natural** opioids derived from the opium poppy.[3][5]
